title: Context Engineering
summary: Manage a model's limited context window deliberately and build an agent harness that applies those decisions across long-running work.
outcome: Control what enters, stays, gets compressed or moves outside the context window, and build a harness that keeps agents productive across long tasks.

project.title: Context-Managed Long-Horizon Agent
deliverables: Run a tool-using agent through a long task where naive context accumulation degrades it
Define an explicit context budget: what to keep, retrieve, compress, offload or discard
Add history compaction, external state, selective memory retrieval and tool-output compression
Wrap the agent in a harness with a progress file, task list, pre-completion verification and step/token limits
Preserve goal, constraints, completed work and pending tasks across the run
Compare against a keep-everything version on coherence, tokens, latency and cost

modules.title: The context window as a resource

topics.d: Treat context as finite rather than 'more is better'.
Degradation from rot, distraction, conflicts and mid-window loss.
See what reaches the model; separate signal from noise.
Rough token shares for instructions, history, retrieval, memory and tools.

modules.outcome: Diagnose when degradation is really a context-management problem.

modules.title: Context selection & assembly

topics.d: Instructions, history, knowledge, memory, tools and state, combined with intent.
Fixed, fetched on demand, summarized or left out.
Rank by relevance, importance, recency and reliability.
Keep instructions, evidence, memory and user data separable.
Remove duplicated, outdated or contradictory material.

modules.outcome: Build the smallest useful context for the model's current decision.

modules.title: Compression & compaction

topics.d: Keep goals, constraints, decisions and open work.
Shrink big results before they re-enter the model.
Incremental and layered summaries for long tasks.
Store precise facts separately when summaries could drop them.
Savings weighed against lost information.

modules.outcome: Shrink context without losing task-critical information.

modules.title: Memory & state offloading

topics.d: Move information out of the window into notes, files or databases.
What must be in the window now vs what can be fetched later.
Save plans, steps, decisions and intermediate results.
Agents that write facts externally and recall them.
Memory for recall vs offloading to free space.

modules.outcome: Build systems that do not need the full history inside the window.

modules.title: Long-context strategies

topics.t: Why big windows do not solve it
topics.d: Larger windows do not remove context problems.
Placement, selective retrieval and restructuring.
Full stuffing, retrieval over history, summaries and selective loading.
When to add more vs retrieve only what matters.

modules.outcome: Pick a strategy for very long documents, conversations and agent runs.

modules.title: Tool context management

topics.d: Schemas and results consume the budget too.
Show only the tools the current task needs.
Summarize or filter big API, search or DB responses.
Store full results outside and re-fetch details.
Prevent long loops piling up observations.

modules.outcome: Keep tool-heavy agents coherent as their action history grows.

modules.title: Context caching & efficiency

topics.t: The cost of resending static context
topics.d: Resending large static context drives cost and latency.
Stable content first to benefit from prompt caching.
Keep slow-changing context apart from fast-changing state.
Trim repetition while keeping what matters.
Track tokens, hit rates, latency and cost.

modules.outcome: Make large-context apps cheaper and faster without hurting quality.

modules.title: Harness engineering

topics.d: Loop, prompts, tools, context, state, permissions and environment around the model.
The same model passes or fails depending on its harness.
Alternate model and tool calls, feed back errors, stop on limits.
Workflow steps, permissions, approvals and safe defaults vs model choice.
An init run, then runs that read progress notes and do one task each.

topics.t: Durable artifacts as the source of truth
topics.d: Progress files, task lists, git history and tests instead of chat.
Agent runs tests, linters and type checks before calling work done.
Concise instruction files and agent-readable docs.
Fresh-context sub-agents that return condensed results.

modules.outcome: Design a harness that keeps an agent on track across tasks larger than one window.

modules.title: Capstone: Context-Managed Long-Horizon Agent

topics.t: A long task that degrades naively
topics.d: Reproduce degradation from unmanaged context.
Decide what to keep, retrieve, compress, offload or discard.
History compaction, external state and tool-output compression.

topics.t: Wrapping the agent in a harness
topics.d: Progress file, task list, verification and limits.

topics.t: Holding the goal across a long run
topics.d: Keep goal, constraints and pending work intact.
Coherence, tokens, latency and cost compared.

modules.outcome: An agent that stays useful across a long, tool-heavy session.
